docs.summary: Loopback HTTP server the prowl CLI talks to. Listens on 127.0.0.1 on a random port and writes the port and a per session token to Library/Cli.lock. Every request must carry that token. Commands run on the main thread.

Whether the CLI is driving the editor: a command is running or one finished in the last few seconds. While true the editor imports, compiles and paces frames as if focused, since nobody is at the window.
Completes on the next editor frame. Survives play mode changes and script reloads, unlike a gameplay frame wait.
